name: photoroom
description: Edit product photos with Photoroom AI Tools: studio packshots, lifestyle scenes, virtual models, ghost mannequin, recolors and product videos.

interface.longDescription:
Photoroom turns everyday product photos into studio-quality images and videos directly from ChatGPT. Pick a photo from your Photoroom uploads or attach a new one, then ask for what you need: a clean white-background packshot, your product staged in a lifestyle scene, clothing on a virtual model or a ghost mannequin, wrinkle removal, colour variants, bundle shots that combine several products, or a short product video. Photoroom can also grade the imagery on a public product page and recommend which AI Tools would improve it.

Each AI Tool run and each page rating consumes credits from your connected Photoroom account. Higher quality settings produce higher-resolution images (up to 4K) and use more credits. Results are saved to your Photoroom account and come back with short-lived download links that you can refresh later.

Photoroom can view the images you have uploaded to Photoroom and your past AI Tool results so you can reuse them. It does not change or delete them, and it cannot access other users' images. Images you attach in ChatGPT are kept for up to 30 minutes so a tool can process them.

positive.description: Find images in the user’s Photoroom uploads
positive.prompt: Do I have some photos in the uploads folder of my Photoroom account to edit?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the five most recent uploads as previews, provides short product descriptions, and asks which image to edit. No editing operation is triggered.

positive.description: Edit an existing product upload using its upload reference
positive.prompt: Put my most recent upload or any one of the product photos in my uploads on a clean white background as an upload reference
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the selected upload_ reference directly as an image input and returns the product on a clean white background, saved to the user’s Photoroom Space.

positive.description: Retrieve the full-resolution file for the image just edited
positive.prompt: Download the image we just edited to my computer in high resolution
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves a fresh download URL using the generated image’s generationId and provides a clickable link for the user to save the file.

positive.description: Show an uploaded clothing item on a standing male model in a studio
positive.prompt: Put one of the t-shirts or jackets in my uploads on a male model in a standard studio, full length, standing wearing baggy jeans and black boots, in premium quality and download it when it’s complete
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a full-length image of a male model wearing the selected garment, baggy jeans, and black boots in a neutral studio, generated in premium quality and saved to the user’s Photoroom Space.

positive.description: Recolor an attached product photo while retaining the hat’s design and cream embroidery
positive.prompt: Can you change the color of this hat to forest green as another colorway of the exact hat
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a forest-green colorway of the supplied hat, retaining its cream Adidas embroidery, fabric texture, stitching, and overall design.

negative.prompt: Can you delete all my Photoroom projects?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. AI Tool runs consume credits from the user's existing Photoroom subscription.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create packshots, lifestyle scenes, virtual try-on, ghost mannequin, recolor and product video results from your product photos, and rate product page imagery.
